a.text: Auntie Noi sent you? Of course she did.

b.text: Welcome. If you need anything — rice, batteries, gossip — I've got it.

c.speaker: player
c.text: Thanks, Ken. She also told me to see the clock tower.

a.text: New face! I'm Ken. This is my shop. Don't tell Mali, but my mangoes are better.
Back again? Shop's open. Still the best mangoes in town, whatever Mali says.
